why: A now contains, beside theorem_19_7_29_hyp, the new theorem_19_7_29_content and theorem_19_7_29_functor (Chapter19/CoveringContent). theorem_19_7_29_content states B's conclusion with the hypothesis IsCompatible added: the topology generated by NatOpenA is metrizable and there is a proper polyfold covering functor (A, T_{|A|}) → (B, T_{|B|}) whose functor is P and whose polyfold structure of B is the one of (F, 𝓕) (Theorem 19.5.3 (2)); the functor is toProperPolyfoldCoveringFunctor (theorem_19_7_29_functor: its structure is (F̂, M) of Theorem 19.7.28 (3), its M-polyfolds are the M(Ψ̂, Ψ̂') of Proposition 19.7.26). B ⇒ main (B_to_main) since B does not use IsCompatible and F̂ has class uniformizers whenever F has (HasClassUniformizers.toBasic). Under IsCompatible all of B follows from main (main_to_B_of_compatible, with the non-item lemma hasClassUniformizers_of_toBasic), hence from A (A_to_B_of_compatible). A_to_B is not obtained because B has no IsCompatible, which does not follow from Definition 19.7.11 (not_isCompatible_twistBasic). B_to_A is not obtained: A also contains the other conjuncts of theorem_19_7_29_hyp (covering uniformizers of B, the open embeddings |Ψ̂|, the sheet-model identities, the fibred-product description through gammaFib) and the identifications of theorem_19_7_29_functor, which B does not state.
overlap: rt_check OK for B_to_main, main_to_B_of_compatible and A_to_B_of_compatible (theorem_19_7_29_hyp, theorem_19_7_29_content, theorem_19_7_29_functor banned). rt_overlap B_to_main: 750 shared project theorems, proof fields of the covering and polyfold constructions reached by unfolding the statement (toPolyfoldConstruction, natTop, M-polyfold infrastructure); no item theorem.
